title: payment_xendit — Thai-adjacent payment provider deep study

key_thai_findings.manifest_summary_mismatch: Manifest says Indonesian and Philippines only; const.py contains full Thai support

architecture.card_flow: direct (browser SDK tokenization + optional 3DS iframe + server-side charge RPC)
architecture.non_card_flow: redirect to gateway-hosted invoice page (v2/invoices API)
architecture.webhook_auth: x-callback-token header compared via constant-time equality
architecture.accounting_postings: entirely inherited from parent payment module; no xendit-specific override
architecture.recurring_3ds_suppression: is_recurring=True flag on charge payload for token reuse

awt_test_steps: POST to webhook URL with valid payment data — verify _process called once
Call token verification with stored webhook token — verify no Forbidden raised
GET return URL with success=true and valid access token — verify state transitions draft to pending
Apply PAID status payment data to transaction — verify state becomes done
Verify zero-decimal rounding: amount 1000.50 rounds to 1000 for IDR/THB-equivalent currency
